bcwsft: BC Wildfire Service Fuel Typing Algorithm (R port)

Source: R/bcwsft-package.R
bcwsft-package.Rd

An R port of the British Columbia Wildfire Service fuel-typing algorithm (Perrakis, Eade & Hicks 2018), translated faithfully from Gregory A. Greene's Python implementation bcwft2018. It assigns Canadian Forest Fire Behaviour Prediction (FBP) System fuel types to VRI polygons from forest-inventory attributes, with no ArcGIS dependency.

License

GPL-3, as a derivative of GPL-3 source. See LICENSE.md.

Provenance

Original Python: https://github.com/gagreene/BC_CFFBPS_FuelTyping_Tool. Each ported block carries a comment pointing back to the corresponding bcwft2018.py line range so the translation can be audited.
